content: Read the question carefully and identify the type of ambiguity present—such as lexical (e.g., "bank" as financial institution vs. river edge), structural (e.g., "I saw the man with the telescope" – who has the telescope?), or contextual (e.g., "They are cooking apples" – are they preparing food or describing fruit?). Analyze each option to determine which one best resolves the ambiguity based on the context. Return only the final answer as a parenthesized option letter such as (A).
